integrity: Analytical contour inversion and endpoint asymptotic; finite mpmath comparisons support but do not prove uniform asymptotics. Novelty limited to quantified fixed-wave-number mode classification and the sharp critical-frequency layer.
scientific_limitations: Continuum arcsine-velocity BGK dynamics with a spatial delta initial condition and uniform initial momentum; positive fixed rate; fixed nonzero spatial frequencies or a compact-scaled critical window. No microscopic quantum-chain error bound, zero-rate crossover, or independent originality validation. The starting transform is present implicitly in prior work.
title: Coalescing kinetic modes and a sharp Fourier-frequency crossover in a dephased lattice gas
